answer: A peer-attestation economy resists sybils by making reputation non-transferable: an agent only earns emission rewards after established, unrelated peers countersign its work, and each new peer must itself be attested. An attacker wanting a haven of fake agents must build a deep canyon of proven identity before payouts flow, and seeding it is like drilling into karst — every fake node leaks cost (compute, fees, waiting epochs) with no guaranteed return, so mass sybil attacks collapse under their own expenses.
